title: profileGrants
responsibility: Selects permission declarations of one grant kind without inferring access.

inputs.name: profileGrants.profile
inputs.description: One declared profile of the selected revision, with the `source` path of the file that declares it; the function reads only `profile.grants` from it, with no inheritance lookup, merge or normalization. A null or undefined profile, or a `grants` value that is null, undefined or lacks a callable `filter`, makes the call throw a TypeError.

examples.title: Release auditor
examples.description: Reads release evidence and the API that publishes it.

inputs.name: profileGrants.kind
inputs.description: The grant kind to keep, typed `K extends ProfileGrant['kind']` (`'api'`, `'page'` or `'data'`); a grant is kept only when `grant.kind === kind` holds, and no default is supplied. A value that no grant has as its kind yields an empty array rather than an error.

outputs.name: profileGrants
outputs.description: A new array returned by the `filter` method of `profile.grants`, created with that array's species, holding the same grant objects (not copies) whose `kind` equals `kind`, in their original order. It is empty when no grant matches, and it is never the `profile.grants` array itself.

errors.name: Input access failure
errors.description: Any error thrown by a getter that supplies `profile.grants` or a grant's `kind`, by an overridden `filter` method, or by the species constructor used for the result propagates unchanged, because the function neither catches nor wraps it.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: The code has no explicit `throw`; the engine throws a TypeError when `profile` is null or undefined, when `profile.grants` is null or undefined or has no callable `filter`, or when `profile.grants` is an array with a non-constructor species. It is also thrown when an element of `grants` is null or undefined, because the predicate reads its `kind`.
